markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (99%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Invasive risk is 0% and simulated frozen-section margins are called clear [F7], though the top concept is unvalidated.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Normal 99%, InSitu 0%, Invasive 0%, Benign 0% [F1] | Near-certain Normal; 0% invasive risk |
| Conformal set | {Normal} at 90% target (alpha 10%) | Single class; 90% dataset coverage |
| Reliability / OOD | 99% reliability, 20th OOD percentile, 12/12 regions [F6] | Typical image; all regions kept |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class (true) | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal (89%–92% similarity) [F5]; contrast InSitu (81%) | Unanimous Normal match in reference |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 0, 1, 9) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score opposing invasion [F2], but 0/20 on AI spot check · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 6, 7, 10) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score opposing invasion [F3]; 20/20 on AI spot check · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 2) · context · Below-typical descriptive score [F4]; 8/20 on AI spot check · Weak
- **HoVer-Net nuclei counts** (regions 3, 8, 11) · context · Insufficient tumor nuclei; 1 neoplastic nucleus in region 8, 10 connective · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Dataset deletion test is faithful (95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197 excludes 0), though region risks here are 0%.
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (95% CI -0.0088 to 0.0064 includes 0); case leans on Unreliable **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Focal in situ carcinoma mimics this embedding, like contrast case `BACH_0043` (InSitu, 81% similarity, differing in tubules and invasion).
- Elevated superior/medial margin scores (88% in region 0) or region 8's single neoplastic nucleus represent true focal atypia.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 4**: Inspect superior and medial margins (88% and 55% segment scores) and region 4 pleomorphism/invasion.
2. **Regions 0, 1, 9**: Confirm true normal two-layered lobules directly, as this concept failed spot-check validation (0/20).
3. **Regions 3, 8**: Verify the single segmented neoplastic nucleus in region 8 and rule out ductal atypia.
